mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate indicates tight monetary conditions, leading to decreased corporate borrowing and investment, which negatively impacts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive when FEDFUNDS is high, or Rank IC < 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive despite UNRATE above 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when both GDPC1 and HOUST grow, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth during late-cycle expansion signals supply-side strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative despite INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strong labor market, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are negative when PAYEMS grows, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real federal spending (RSAFS) indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns are negative when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) alongside unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates tightening monetary policy and labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: Returns are positive when both FEDFUNDS and UNRATE rise, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High federal funds rate during a monetary tightening cycle leads to decreased liquidity, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are positive when FEDFUNDS is high, or Rank IC < 0.03.
